propositions: Teams cannot run multiple tracker projects against one codebase because the bridge is hard-wired to a single project at three points: JiraConfig.project scalar, JQL fetcher, and outbound applier guard.

A shared ticket store between N repos and N tracker projects must own the project set via .bridge_state/projects.json to prevent each repo's diff from misinterpreting other projects' tickets as remote deletions.

Each ticket records its source project and assigned repos; the project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there), resolving to a legacy default via idempotent ensure migration.

Multi-project inbound fetch must fan-out over configured projects with per-project enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps) merged into a shared snapshot; outbound dispatch targets per-ticket project and relaxes the cross-project guard to set membership.

Stores with more than one project must carry the multi-project-bridge capability in .store-compat.json required_capabilities; older binaries lacking it refuse writes while single-project stores remain backward-compatible.
Pre-feature stores migrate to tri-state project semantics with zero events written; migration resolves absent tickets to the recorded legacy default via check-then-act ensure unit.
